Tenable: Football Edition!
EasyMediumHard
Created by Aiden and Craig
How to play

Each round shows a board of empty slots. Name one club, player or manager at a time and lock it in. With 2 or 3 players you take turns; solo, it's you against the board.

The tower then scans up from the bottom. If it stops on your club, you score a point for every slot that club fills. If it runs all the way to the top, you lose a life.

Three lives each per round. A wrong answer is a yellow card, and losing all three is a red card until the next round. If the shot clock runs out, that costs a life too. Not sure? You can pass, but that costs a life too. Fill the last slot for a 2 point bonus.
